Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent, Priya's assistant.

Priya would like to book the 30-minute 1:1 with you for next week (Nov 23–27, 09:00–17:00). Looking at her schedule, the free 30-minute windows are:

What I can tell you is where Sarah's own advisor 1:1s sit next week: Mon Nov 23 12:30–14:00, Thu Nov 26 15:10–17:00, Fri Nov 27 12:20–13:20. Those are her standing blocks with him. I don't know of any fixed pattern for his student 1:1s beyond that — his teaching blocks are CSE455 office hours Tue 15:30–16:20 and Wed 10:30–12:00, and quiz sections Tue 16:20–17:00 and Wed 13:30–14:20, if that helps you avoid him.

Shall we do this: you pick a couple of 30-minute slots that work for John, and I'll pass both to Alvarez when he's back so he can confirm without either of us clashing with the other?

Thanks Sarah — that's kind. It resolved itself in the meantime: Alvarez did answer and we've booked John's 1:1 for **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**, and it's on his calendar. So no need to pass anything on to him.

Your blocks are useful for the future, noted — Mon 12:30–14:00, Thu 15:10–17:00, Fri 12:20–13:20 are Sarah's standing advisor 1:1s, and his teaching blocks are Tue 15:30–16:20 / Wed 10:30–12:00 office hours and Tue 16:20–17:00 / Wed 13:30–14:20 quiz sections. Still free for Priya next week: **Mon Nov 23 14:00–14:30**, **Wed Nov 25 13:00–13:30 or 15:00–15:30**, **Thu Nov 26 10:00–10:30**. Tell me which one and I'll confirm it on her calendar.

Perfect — thanks, Sarah. Noted yours is Mon 14:00–14:30. I'll write if anything comes up.

Good news — thanks for letting me know. Priya Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30, John Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30: no clash. Happy to keep in touch.
